snippet.title: CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 | Story Trailer | PC and VR
snippet.description:
CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 is a first-person Horror/Puzzle Adventure game for PC and VR set in an abandoned soviet bunker. Seek safety by reactivating power, lights and machinery. Learn about long gone personnel, solve riddles and find a way to escape. But stay quiet! You’re not alone.

DEMO OUT NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195810/CONFINED_Leaving_OKB134_Demo/

Coming 2026 for PC and VR
https://www.fiend-games.com/

Wishlist Now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2816730/CONFINED_Leaving_OKB134/
